title: Scalar mates preserve the coefficient-unit arrow

source.place: paragraph (1), applying coefficient extension to the positive section class; trace proof paragraph (1), its adjunction

statement: For a unital condensed coefficient map a:Lambda to Lambda-prime and a scheme Y, let R and R-prime be specified right derived direct images for P=ProjectiveLine Y. Let s be a normalized RestrictionSquare [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-scalars], and let uY,uP be Endpoint data for the regular modules whose underlying maps are coefficientMap a [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-endpoints]. Then derivedScalars(a,Y)(coefficientUnitPush Lambda Y R), followed by s.mate at the regular unit on P and R-prime of uP.iso.hom, equals uY.iso.hom followed by coefficientUnitPush Lambda-prime Y R-prime [def-diagonal-coefficient-unit-push]. No flatness or nonzero-ring assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Transpose through extension/restriction on Y. The mate identity expresses the transposed mate using the inverse restriction square and the transposed P endpoint. Replace both endpoint transposes by Endpoint.normalization. The ordinary unit square is coefficient-map compatibility of condensedPushforwardHom. Apply the single-object derived square, its naturality, and cancel the exact single comparisons. Transpose back by injectivity of the adjunction bijection.

lean.statement:
theorem scalar_unit_push
    {Λ Λ' : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}}
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] [MonObj Λ'] [IsCommMonObj Λ']
    (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom a] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (R : DiagonalRightDerived (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)))
    (R' : DiagonalRightDerived (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ' (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)))
    (s : RestrictionSquare a (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) R R')
    (uY : Endpoint a (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj Λ Y))
      (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj Λ' Y)) (coefficientMap a Y))
    (uP : Endpoint a (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)))
      (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj Λ' (ProjectiveLine Y)))
      (coefficientMap a (ProjectiveLine Y))) :
    (derivedScalars a Y).map (coefficientUnitPush Λ Y R) ≫
        (s.mate a).app (unit Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)) ≫ R'.R.map uP.iso.hom =
      uY.iso.hom ≫ coefficientUnitPush Λ' Y R'
